title: Staying in academia after extended leave
title_zh: 长期休假后留在学术界
abstract: Returning to academia after extended leave often depends on luck and goodwill. We need better and formalized systems to facilitate returns and retention, argues Theresa Mercer.
abstract_zh: 在长期休假后重返学术界往往取决于运气和好意。我们需要更好、更制度化的系统来促进回归和留任，这是Theresa Mercer的观点。
snippet: Returning to academia after extended leave often depends on luck and goodwill. We need better and formalized systems to facilitate returns and retention, argues Theresa Mercer.
